subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining parts of #97971 should become core follow-ups now, and should they be split into docs, update-diff, and audit-scope items?
rationale: Current main already implements several central asks, while the remaining asks cross security-sensitive setup, update transparency, auth documentation, and audit policy that automation should not choose as one combined fix.

options.title: Split remaining gaps
options.body: Create or canonicalize focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff output, and self-healing audit scope while leaving implemented behavior in place.

options.title: Limit to docs
options.body: Accept only the systemd SecretRef documentation gap for now and defer update-diff and audit-scope changes until stronger user evidence appears.

options.title: Close as covered
options.body: Close the broad bundle if maintainers decide the existing dry-run, token fragment, wrapper, doctor, and audit surfaces are sufficient for the reported workflows.

recommendation.title: Split remaining gaps
recommendation.body: Create or canonicalize focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff output, and self-healing audit scope while leaving implemented behavior in place.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest contribution trail across the affected update, dashboard token, Gateway CLI, docs, and audit surfaces.
